categories.name: Accuracy
categories.reason: Retained facts checked against signed CBA, full HHS contract cells, WNBA releases and BBR. All 22 original URLs audited; unavailable sources replaced rather than treated as verification.

categories.name: Information gain
categories.reason: Eight replicated budgets, 21 player inputs and eight salary-clearing scenarios expose Wilson floating salary and the Loyd-only shortfall. Representative search-result comparison completed; exact top-ten Google result extraction unavailable.

categories.name: Effort and replication cost
categories.reason: Signed agreement read by section, public contract HTML archived, player inputs summed and all scenario arithmetic asserted in a reproducible script.

categories.name: Originality
categories.reason: Independent conditional roster comparison, not destination reporting. Separates retention of contracted players from retention of championship rotation.

categories.name: Experience and expertise
categories.reason: Real FCB byline and author link, explicit cap method and public evidence. No invented expert identity or firsthand reporting.

categories.name: Main content and layout
categories.reason: Title and H1 match, direct-answer intro, original cap table near opening, downloadable inputs and explanatory notes. Manuscript QA only; rendered site checks remain deployment work.

categories.name: Transparency
categories.reason: Visible AI disclosure, data-through date, source snapshot timing, explicit model assumptions and verified source list distinguish facts, calculations and hypothetical judgments.

categories.name: Writing craft
categories.reason: No em dashes or promotional cliches, source-linked key figures, HTML source anchors explicitly open in new tabs. Concrete trade-offs replace unsupported certainty.

categories.name: People-first purpose
categories.reason: Readers get the roster answer and reusable dataset without treating a ceiling as a forecast, a budget as a legal ruling or speculation as reporting.

categories.name: Human voice
categories.reason: Specific financial and lineup choices in plain language, with inflated adjectives and formulaic guarantees removed. No AI detector used.
